description: A JavaScript test file with runs of '});' lines (a bare '}' is not distinctive, '});' is). Frames 1-3 cover the whole file. Frame 4 is a small view whose only full lines are '});' x3 and a blank line; it matches lines 28-31 and 51-54 equally well. The stitcher must not guess: it emits ambiguous_overlap, treats the frame as unplaced (gap_detected) and renders it as its own segment after a gap marker (REQ-STI-06).
